profile.org_note: Family-owned: Hayden Watson is owner and chairman, Dennis Murphy is CEO and Steve Klingman is president, with a COO (Craig Smith) and a chief of staff (Keith Thomajan); the company publishes no leadership page, so the map is built from its press releases. The field is run as six market regions, each led by a Regional Director, with Regional Vice Presidents above them. Land is handled in-house (regional land acquisition and land development managers, forward planning) and by the company's own 2015 statement rolls up to the CEO; a Redmond-based Vice President of Land Acquisition seat was advertised around late 2025 and has since closed, but no land executive is named publicly. Finance sits with a CFO (Jim Sansburn, directory-sourced), a VP of Finance and Accounting and a Controller. Region leaders shown are inferred from which executive the company quotes for each market.
profile.summary: Conventional for-sale homebuilder and the largest privately owned builder in the Pacific Northwest by its own description: more than 28,000 homes since 1989, selling entry-level and workforce-priced homes in secondary and rural markets across Oregon, Washington, Idaho and Montana. Owned by the Watson family and run from a new Redmond, Oregon support centre opened in 2025. It sources and develops much of its own land, has bought lot positions from other builders, and publishes no lot counts, lenders or capital partners, so it is a plausible but untested land-banking prospect.
